title: The Ore Beast
text: A rock-skinned beast grazes on a hillside, as big as an ox, chewing ore with a sound like a millstone. Sparks fly from its teeth. Behind it lies a trail of its droppings, and its droppings are pure iron.

options.label: Follow it and gather what it leaves.

outcomes.text: Unpleasant work, and profitable, and the beast keeps looking back.

options.label: Hunt it for its metal hide.

outcomes.text: Its hide is half metal, and it fights like it.

options.label: The gentlest tries to lead it home.

outcomes.text: It follows. It will graze the House's slag heap for years.
It wanders off, unbothered, and leaves you a little more iron for your trouble.
